text: Northwind Signals raised a $42M Series B led by Fernbrook Ventures to expand its go-to-market team across North America and Europe.
Northwind Signals is hiring a Revenue Operations Manager in San Francisco to own CRM hygiene, lead routing and forecasting.
Meridian Pipeline appointed Dana Whitfield as Chief Revenue Officer, joining from a larger sales engagement vendor.
Halstead Analytics is hiring two Account Executive roles in London to cover mid-market accounts in the UK and Ireland.
Brunnen Systems has started using Salesforce Sales Cloud, according to new job listings and its trust centre.
Kestrel Works is hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to rebuild its customer dashboard in React.
Sundara Labs named Arjun Pillai as its new Chief Financial Officer ahead of a planned expansion.
Pixelforge raised a $6M seed round to grow its consumer design app.
Cadence RevOps is hiring a Sales Operations Lead in Austin to run its internal CRM and quoting process.
Orbit Ledger closed an $18M Series A to scale its outbound sales team and enter the US market.
Tallgrass Data is hiring a GTM Engineer to automate enrichment, routing and sequencing across its revenue stack.
Vantaloop has moved its sales team onto HubSpot Sales Hub, replacing a spreadsheet-based pipeline.
Quillmark raised a $9M Series A to hire its first dedicated sales team.
Halstead Analytics is hiring a Data Engineer to maintain its warehouse pipelines.
